name: Parts of the Soul

gist.Thep, the Court Scribe: Each turn places a Soul Shard from the discard pile into play.
gist.Necromancy: Ability: each turn summons a creature from the discard pile as a free action; Soul Shards keep their effects.
gist.Cute Nerd Magenta: Discards a card to put any card from the deck into the discard pile.
gist.Alice, the Puppeteer Girl: Hits per creature that stayed on his board.
gist.Soul Shard Sekhem: Summoned from the discard pile: hits a target for every different Soul Shard there.
gist.Soul Shard Khet: Summoned from the discard pile: summons another creature from it.
gist.Soul Shard Ka: Summoned from the discard pile: fetches and summons a small creature from the deck.
gist.Soul Shard Ren: Summoned from the discard pile: searches any card.
gist.Soul Shard Ib: Summoned from the discard pile: heals its hero.
gist.Soul Shard Shut: Summoned from the discard pile: mills five more cards.
gist.Sandy Blob: Stings you each time an arrival effect goes off.
gist.Adventurousness: Ability: spend the action on gold.
gist.Book of Doom: Gold for small hits on many targets.

plan: Soul Shards only work when they come out of the discard pile, so that is where Jun-ho wants them. Magenta puts them there, Necromancy and Thep bring one or two back every turn, and each return pays: a search, a heal, another creature, a hit from Sekhem that counts the Shards still in the pile, a sting from the Sandy Blob. A Shard you kill simply goes back to where it is most useful. The loop runs through Thep and the Necromancy heroes.

looks.early: Shards going into the discard pile on purpose.
looks.mid: Two Shards returning every turn, each with an effect; a Sandy Blob stinging.
looks.late: A discard pile with every Shard in it and Sekhem returning again.

opening.tell: He is filling his discard pile and the Shards on the board have done nothing yet.
opening.why: A Shard is only strong arriving from the discard pile, so killing one is a favour; his heroes are frail.

midgame.tell: Thep and Necromancy return two Shards a turn.
midgame.why: Freeze Thep and half the returns stop; steal the Sandy Blob; sweeping sends the Shards home.

crisis.tell: Sekhem returns every turn and its hit counts the Shards in the pile.
crisis.why: It is one hit a turn on one hero: shield it and keep killing the hero who summons it.

endgame.tell: Thep is down and only one Necromancy hero remains.
endgame.why: One return a turn is not enough.

opening.board: Jun-ho discards a Soul Shard with Magenta and sketches something.
Thep places a Soul Shard Ren, which searches a card.

midgame.board: Khet returns and brings Ka with it; the Blob stings twice.
Your sweep puts five Shards in his discard pile.

options.text: Kill a Necromancy hero before his turn

crisis.board: Sekhem returns and hits for six Shards.
Ib heals Thep each time it returns.
